gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-tirhu: Commanding and urban, Capture It draws every letter like a pencil that never presses harder, with openings nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans Tirhuta, a plain sans, is its open opposite.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-ugari: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps its letter mouths open like chalk arcs left unjoined, with caps and lowercase sitting close in height. Capture It, built with strokes free of thick and thin, earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-vai: Words in Noto Sans Vai read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with generous space where each curve meets its stem. Against the nearly sealed Capture It, they feel open and settled.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-wanch: Noto Sans Wancho has a hulking lowercase, pressed hard like thick chalk, with an e that gapes at its terminal. And Capture It, whose tails match its stems, matches that heft while staying nearly sealed.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-waran: Capture It has no hairlines and no swells anywhere, just towering letters with openings almost shut. Noto Sans Warang Citi lets wide channels run into each counter, so the two feel like a locked door beside an open one.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-yi: Noto Sans Yi has a deep midsection in its lowercase, and its rounds stay unsealed like an unlatched hook. Capture It, drawn with a constant-width pen line, stands tall and shut beside that sans-serif.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-zanab: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with a lofty x-height. Capture It is just as tall but nearly sealed, so beside the sans' wide gaps the two feel like a clenched fist next to an open hand.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-traditiona: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, with bowls filling the line. Noto Traditional Nushu would keep a longer passage feeling friendly, while Capture It holds its string-steady, sealed shapes apart.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-numans: Capture It towers with an urban, commanding x-height, its letters nearly sealed shut. Numans sprawls beside it with an s whose ends hang far from the spine, and tracking pushed well past normal.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-onest: Approachable Onest has short ascenders above big bowls, with no ink pooling where curves turn in. Shrink Capture It and its nearly sealed letters would clog, so it needs the size.
